title: Generating Transgene-Free Naive Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Using Modified Sendai Viral System
author: Washizu, Yamanaka, et al.

steps.title: Prepare iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium
steps.instruction: Condition iMEFs for three days to generate t2iLGö medium, then add Y‑27632 before use.

substeps.instruction: Day 1 (≈30 min): Warm fibroblast medium to 37 °C; coat a 15 cm dish with 0.1 % gelatin and incubate at 20‑25 °C ≥15 min. Thaw one frozen iMEF vial (4 × 10⁶ cells) in a 37 °C water bath, transfer to a 50 mL tube containing 19 mL fibroblast medium, and plate 2.5 × 10⁴ cells / cm² (≈4 × 10⁶ cells in 20 mL) onto the gelatin‑coated dish. Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for >12 h.
Day 2 (≈20 min): Prepare t2iLGö medium, warm to 20‑25 °C (do NOT add Y‑27632). Aspirate fibroblast medium and add 20 mL t2iLGö medium. Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h.
Day 3 (≈30 min): Collect the conditioned medium, filter through a 0.45 µm low‑protein‑binding filter, aliquot, and store at –20 °C (or at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks after thawing).

steps.title: Add Y‑27632 to conditioned medium
steps.instruction: Immediately before each use, supplement the iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö medium with 10 µM Y‑27632 to obtain iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium.

steps.title: Coat plates for feeder‑free passage
steps.instruction: Prepare Matrigel‑coated and gelatin‑coated 6‑well plates for separating iMEFs from naive iPSCs.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Matrigel 4 µL / cm² (e.g., 38.4 µL Matrigel + 1 mL PBS per well) and coat one 6‑well plate; incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.
Add 0.1 % gelatin solution to a second 6‑well plate; incubate at 20‑25 °C ≥15 min.

steps.title: Detach naive iPSCs (first feeder‑free passage)
steps.instruction: Harvest naive iPSCs while iMEFs remain attached to gelatin, then transfer iPSCs to Matrigel.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium from the naive iPSC‑containing well and wash once with PBS.
Add 1 mL Accutase, incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Pipette to dissociate cells, transfer the suspension to a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL wash medium, and centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium.
Aspirate the gelatin solution from the gelatin‑coated dish, plate the cell suspension, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 5 % O₂ for 2 h (do not move the plate) to allow iMEFs to re‑attach to gelatin.
Aspirate the Matrigel‑PBS from the Matrigel‑coated well, gently collect the supernatant (containing naive iPSCs) from the gelatin plate, and plate it onto the Matrigel‑coated well.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 5 % O₂ and change medium every other day.

steps.title: Repeat iMEF removal (optional)
steps.instruction: Four days after the first passage, repeat the iMEF‑removal procedure to completely eliminate residual iMEFs.

steps.title: Passage feeder‑free naive iPSCs (subsequent passages)
steps.instruction: Maintain and passage naive iPSCs on Matrigel using iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a Matrigel‑coated 6‑well plate as described above and warm iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium to 20‑25 °C.
Aspirate medium from the naive iPSC well, wash with PBS, add 1 mL Accutase, and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Dissociate cells, transfer to a 15 mL tube with 5 mL wash medium, and centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant, resuspend cells in 2 mL iMEF‑conditioned t2iLGö+Y medium.
Aspirate the Matrigel‑PBS from the coated well and plate 2 mL of the cell suspension per well.
